steps.title: Verify App Meta-Configuration
steps.description: Ensure the application name 'Voice Control Assistant' and package 'com.voicecontrolassistant.app' are correctly declared inside meta file.

steps.title: Configure Accessibility Service Viewport Rules
steps.description: Establish target configurations for inspecting screen UI tree elements, checking class IDs, and performing clicks.

steps.title: Add Hardware and API Permissions in AndroidManifest
steps.description: Configure RECORD_AUDIO, SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW, and CAMERA permissions to support background assistant services.

steps.title: Establish local storage key-value configuration
steps.description: Develop and verify settings configuration UI so users can select models and store their Gemini API Keys securely locally.

steps.title: Set up settings persistence in MainActivity
steps.description: Write Local SharedPreferences code inside MainActivity to retrieve and display customized Gemini variables cleanly.

steps.title: Initialize SpeechRecognizer with dual language localization
steps.description: Initialize a SpeechRecognizer listener and bind it to intercept speech inputs and direct them directly to the interpretation system.

steps.title: Integrate Floating Assistant Mic UI layer
steps.description: Integrate floating window layouts and custom animations to show current listening, processing, and idle status orbs.

steps.title: Establish secure network communication routines with Gemini
steps.description: Create standard HttpURLConnection procedures inside a separate execution thread to make network connections to Gemini generateContent endpoint.

steps.title: Develop robust Gemini JSON output cleaner
steps.description: Develop automated cleansing filters that extract strict JSON block structures by parsing the content from the first brace to the last.

steps.title: Implement multi-action schema parsing and robust validation
steps.description: Extract raw JSON commands array and validate every single command parameter before adding them to the sequential execution queue.

steps.title: Fix Search, Type and Submit Pipeline
steps.description: Map Gemini natural language search actions directly into the actual editable text fields and automate enter/submit clicks by eliminating invalid compilation targets like ACTION_IME_ACTION.

steps.title: Construct Sequential Non-Blocking Command Queue
steps.description: Design an executing loop that runs sequential actions step-by-step, completely waiting for UI layout states before triggering subsequent events.

steps.title: Incorporate Robust UI State Polling and Retries
steps.description: Develop UI polling logic to perform retry attempts when rendering delays occur, preventing execution crashes on slow devices.

steps.title: Prevent Race Conditions & Queue Overlaps
steps.description: Add safety logic to clean and abort running queues whenever a new voice command triggers mid-execution.

steps.title: Integrate Strict Debug Logging & Performance Tracking
steps.description: Expose full verbose logs to print USER TEXT, GEMINI COMMAND COUNT, individual commands, active executions, completions, and failures.

steps.title: Verify Native Accessibility Fallbacks and Dialogs
steps.description: Implement global gesture handlers for System Home, Back, Volume, and Flashlight adjustments.

steps.title: Building Voice Control Assistant
steps.description: Assemble, compile, and build the updated Voice Control Assistant using Gradle command line utilities.
